intro.text: Your sheets already know the answers.

s1.text: Meet InsightFlow. An AI analyst that reads your sheets and documents.

s2.text: Connect a Google Sheet in seconds. Gmail, Slack and Notion join in one click.

s3.text: Ask in plain words. Every number is calculated by code, then spelled out for you.

s4.text: It drafts the email, Slack post, or Notion page. Nothing goes out until you approve.

s5.text: Even PDFs and invoices turn into rows you can question.

outro.text: Ask your first question today. insightsflow.vercel.app
